current_role: Senate Democratic Leader (since 2017); expected to become majority leader in January 2027
summary: Chuck Schumer, a New York senator since 1999, has led Senate Democrats since 2017 and was majority leader from 2021 to 2025. After Democrats won the Senate in November 2026 he said he would be re-elected majority leader, but five incoming senators, including Michigan’s Abdul El-Sayed, said they would oppose him; the closed-door leadership vote is expected in early December, and no one has formally challenged him.
